verdict.rationale: Docs show Gusto Embedded Payroll is largely API-first, with explicit API endpoints for core actions (payroll, contractor payments, time off approvals) and note that partners can 'call the approve/decline endpoints directly from your own UI' instead of using the pre-built flow, indicating real API/UI parity for several workflows. However, some features (e.g., 401(k) Guideline enrollment) are only described as accessible via 'pre-built flows' with no documented raw-API equivalent, so parity isn't confirmed universally. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every pre-built UI Flow (benefits enrollment, 401k, onboarding flows) has a fully equivalent raw API path, and independent/hands-on verification of full parity.
